page.layout: One printed page, title page. Full-width title block at top; below it a central woodcut of an anchor with a serpent (engraving, no text); then imprint lines centred at the foot. Faint show-through of the reverse page is visible and is not transcribed.
page.notes: Title page with printer's anchor woodcut between the author line and the imprint. Show-through from the reverse side is faintly visible in the centre and right and is omitted. The title's long s is rendered as s; the "s" forms in the print were read as plain s. Printed initials in the title are capitals as set. The final line of the imprint is in roman capitals.
